scope: Partial Native component capture: real ApplicationHost.Init, discovered factories, ServerConfigurationManager, MyXmlSerializer and NetworkManager select captured ports/certificate and real bind inputs. Real SetupJellyfinWebServer starts Production Kestrel; selected Startup BaseUrl/ForwardedHeaders/Exception/HTTPS-redirection/MVC middleware and real ConfigurationController/SystemController/SystemManager execute. An explicitly bound actual ApplicationHost.OnConfigurationUpdated delegate observes ordered named/system effects. No replacement algorithm or handwritten Native result is used.
controlledGateways: uninvoked media encoder/library/file-system gateways throw if called
MockNetworkSettings supplies a loopback interface input; it does not certify OS enumeration
initial IsPortAuthorized=true is a declared post-FindParts system input
completionBoundary: A declared system-event barrier waits for the actual AppHost handler body, including its original thrown failure. The Native EventHelper still owns its following catch/log tail. Native logs are optional raw diagnostics and never an event-count or log-count acceptance gate. Each real endpoint is stopped/disposed, connection refusal is observed, and its physical port is rebound.
partialLimitations: No full Program/Main, InitializeServices/FindParts, RunStartupTasks, startup-message gate, EF/session/authentication service or hosted notifier graph
No Node production listener, pending-restart or boot conformance yet
No Unix socket, real interface enumeration, multicast, discovery, outbound network, hardware or media executor
A declared fallback URL bounds the empty-address Kestrel case; the full application's default endpoint remains outside this capture
Native exception identities and logs are raw diagnostics, never acceptance criteria
